definition.child: the round produced by the mutation (same round id as the experience record)
definition.reselection: that child's round id later appears as 'father node' of another round in same (benchmark,variant)
definition.descendant_score_retention: share of direct offspring whose after >= child's after
definition.structural_component_retention: share of success children with >=1 offspring having identical graph.py SHA-256

behavioral_note: graph text / parent-child links alone cannot establish capability retention on new tasks
causal_caveat: Early children have more remaining selection opportunities; matched quartiles reduce but do not eliminate survivorship. Observational only.
